Leah (AE): BankZ is asking about Private/VPC deploy for a short POC. Main asks: preserve client source IP, TLS-inspect proxy in path, and exact firewall allowlist. Can SE/NetOps advise?
Mark (SE): Quick summary: we can do PrivateLink for control plane and run runtime in-customer VPC behind their TGW. Client IP preservation depends on whether their proxy/NAT does SNAT. If they use a transparent forwarder that supports PROXY protocol, we can accept the original IP. Otherwise X-Forwarded-For is the fallback.
Ravi (NetOps): We need explicit ports/CIDRs to give our security team. Also do we recommend VPC endpoints for S3/ECR?
Mark (SE): Yes recommend VPC endpoints for artifacts to avoid internet egress. Minimal egress checklist: TCP 443 to PrivateLink ENIs (control plane), TCP 443 to artifact endpoints or S3 endpoint, UDP/TCP 53 to resolver, UDP 123 to NTP (optional). If proxy inspects TLS, ask them to forward client identity via PROXY protocol or XFF. Example firewall lines for them: "allow 10.20.0.0/16:443 to privatelink-eni, allow VPC-endpoint-IPs:443 to s3, allow 0.0.0.0/0:443 only if no endpoint"
Nina (Security): We'll need SOC2 cert, encryption-in-transit details, and confirmation of KMS integration for BYOK if they plan to use customer-managed keys. Also confirm whether runtime can run with zero internet egress (yes if S3/ECR endpoints + control plane via PrivateLink are allowed).
Ravi (NetOps): What about TGW NAT behavior vs interface endpoint for preserving src IP?
Mark (SE): TGW + NAT will SNAT. Interface endpoints keep traffic within AZ and do not SNAT by themselves. If traffic traverses a proxy appliance that reorigins the connection, source IP will change. Architecture options: 1) Put a transparent TLS-inspecting proxy that passes PROXY protocol to our NLB -> runtime; 2) Terminate TLS at proxy and set X-Forwarded-For; 3) Use a sidecar/proxy that preserves src IP if bank's infra allows. If customer policy forbids header forwarding, you cannot recover original IP.
Leah (AE): Pricing note: Private deployment has a platform fee + infra. For the POC we can provide a 30-day reduced infra rate; I'll follow up with a draft quote.
infra-bot: Created channel #poc-bankz-248000. Invitees: Leah (AE), Mark (SE), Ravi (NetOps), Nina (Security)
Leah (AE): Action items: 1) Leah to request BankZ VPC CIDR + proxy ops contact. 2) Mark to produce 1-page diagram comparing "Privatelink + proxy(PROXY)" vs "TGW + NAT" with ports to whitelist. 3) Nina to compile SOC2 + KMS notes. 4) Ravi to confirm if their proxy can emit PROXY protocol (ETA EOD).
Mark (SE): I'll post the 1-pager later today.
Ravi (NetOps): I'll confirm proxy capability and ping back here.
